fields.name: ref
fields.help: Internal reference number in case it differs from the manufacturer's lot/serial number

fields.name: standard_price
fields.help:
Value of the lot (automatically computed in AVCO).
        Used to value the product when the purchase cost is not known (e.g. inventory adjustment).
        Used to compute margins on sale orders.

fields.name: expiration_date
fields.help: This is the date on which the goods with this Serial Number may become dangerous and must not be consumed.

fields.name: use_date
fields.help: This is the date on which the goods with this Serial Number start deteriorating, without being dangerous yet.

fields.name: removal_date
fields.help: This is the date on which the goods with this Serial Number should be removed from the stock and not be counted in the Fresh On Hand Stock anymore. This date will be used in FEFO removal strategy.

fields.name: alert_date
fields.help: Date to determine the expired lots and serial numbers using the filter "Expiration Alerts".

fields.name: product_expiry_alert
fields.help: The Expiration Date has been reached.

definitions.documentation:
Defines if we want to display all fields in the stock.production.lot form view.
It will if the record exists (`id` set) or if we precised it into the context.
This compute depends on field `name` because as it has always a default value, it'll be
always triggered.

validation_messages.message: You can only move a lot/serial to a new location if it exists in a single location.
You are not allowed to change the product linked to a serial or lot number if some stock moves have already been created with that number. This would lead to inconsistencies in your stock.
You cannot change the company of a lot/serial number currently in a location belonging to another company.

definitions.documentation:
returns partner_ids that are directly delivered the product of the lot/SN, i.e. not
lots/SNs that are consumed within a MO. This means this search is NOT symmetric with the
partner_ids field within the form view since it uses different logic that isn't efficient
enough for this search due to it being usable within the list view.

Retrieve all delivery IDs (outgoing picking) linked to the lots
in self and all the lots found when parcouring the produce lines.
:return: A dictionary where keys are the IDs of the original 'stock.lot'
          records (self) and values are lists of associated 'stock.picking' IDs.
